purpose: Teach: 除け/処方/知見/養う/備える/凶/調書/力強く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、伝統医療の厄除けの慣習、興味深く読みました。
lines.en: Ren, I found your paper on traditional healing charms quite fascinating.
lines.style: Warm, professorial opening. Genuine interest in the voice — not performing approval. Slow, deliberate pace that signals this is a real compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。薬の処方、地域差、調査しました。
lines.en: Yes. I surveyed the regional differences in how medication was actually prescribed.
lines.style: Steady, slightly hesitant — he's gathering his thoughts. Quiet confidence underneath, like he's remembering his own research. No rush.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 公衆衛生の知見、現代社会に欠かせないですね。
lines.en: That kind of public health knowledge is invaluable to understanding modern society.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured tone — she's connecting the dots aloud. Respect in her voice, like she's seeing something important crystallize.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。家族が病人を養う制度、地域、差があります。
lines.en: Yes. How families cared for the sick varied so much depending on the region.
lines.style: Quiet, precise. He's not lecturing — sharing a detail he noticed. Slight upward lilt at the end, like he's inviting her to see what he saw.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 災害に備える文化、地域社会に根付いていますね。
lines.en: That culture of disaster preparation really was woven into the fabric of local communities.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation in the tone. Speaking a little slower, letting the weight of the observation sit. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。凶作の年、人々はどう生き延びたか、論じました。
lines.en: Yes. I looked at how people actually survived during years of crop failure.
lines.style: Careful, almost tender — he's talking about real suffering. Small, steadying breath. Conviction underneath, like this matters to him personally.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の調書、貴重な一次資料ですね。
lines.en: Those historical records are genuinely rare primary sources.
lines.style: Slight lean forward in the voice. Engaged now — her interest sharpens when he gets into specifics. Warm, encouraging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。庶民が力強く生きた様子、心を打たれます。
lines.en: Yes. How ordinary people found the strength to endure — it really moved me.
lines.style: Soft, genuine emotion in the voice. Not performing feeling — actually feeling it. Trailing slightly, like he's still sitting with what he found. Vulnerable.
